verdict.rationale: The evidence pack names no official Open WebUI SDK. Developers can still build against the product: API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses, and the gateway exposes workspaces as OpenAI-compatible models, so any OpenAI-style client library works. In-product Python Functions and plugins add a server-side extension surface. Missing for 10: a first-party SDK package in any language, SDK reference documentation, a published OpenAPI spec (the probes returned 404), and independent corroboration of developer workflows.
